name: FLESHBREAK
source:
You play as Lennox, a man navigating a collapsing society consumed by a fast-spreading, flesh-transforming infection inspired by the horrors of SCP-610. Victims don’t simply die — they mutate into expanding, writhing masses of living flesh that continue to move, reach, and hunt. Food is scarce, trust is fragile, and anyone you meet might already be at the edge of transformation.

Travel with your wife Horu, your younger sister Alora, and the aspiring scientist Axton as you search for safety, supplies, and the possibility of a cure. Every encounter forces you to make difficult moral decisions that directly shape the fate of your group.

[Edited from [url=https://horubrain.itch.io/fleshbreak]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Lennox，一个在因SCP-610的恐怖而引发的快速传播、肉体变形感染所吞噬的崩溃社会中前行的人。受害者不会简单地死去——它们会变异成不断膨胀、扭动的活体肉块，继续移动、触及和狩猎。食物稀缺，信任脆弱，你遇到的任何人可能已经处于转型的边缘。

与你的妻子荷鲁、你的妹妹阿洛拉和有抱负的科学家阿克斯顿一起旅行，寻找安全、补给和治疗的可能性。每一次遭遇都迫使你做出艰难的道德决定，这些决定直接影响你的团队的命运。

[编辑自[url=https://horubrain.itch.io/fleshbreak]itch.io[/url]]
